info.name: Incident Triage API
info.description: One request per endpoint. Set the base_url collection variable to target another deployment. Every request sends a fresh X-Correlation-ID, which the API echoes and uses as the Langfuse trace key.

request.description: App status and database reachability. Expect 200 with {status, database}.

Hybrid keyword and semantic search. Enable the optional filters as needed; tags is comma-separated and all must match. Expect 200 with {total, results[id, title, snippet, score]}; 422 for an invalid filter value.
One full incident record by id (variable incident_id). Expect 200; 404 {error, detail, correlation_id} if the id does not exist.

Upsert a batch of incidents, then embed pending rows. This example writes inc-90001 to the database. Expect 200 with counts (ingested, updated, skipped, duplicates, invalid, embedded, embedding_pending) and any rejected items; 422 for a malformed body. Sending the same body again returns skipped = 1.

body.raw:
[
  {
    "id": "inc-90001",
    "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:30:00Z",
    "environment": "prod",
    "service": "payments-api",
    "severity": "high",
    "title": "Database connection timeouts during checkout",
    "description": "Checkout requests failed with connection timeouts to the primary database after a traffic spike.",
    "resolution_summary": "Raised the connection pool size and added a read replica for reporting queries.",
    "tags": ["database", "timeout"]
  }
]

request.description: No body: stores nothing and only embeds rows still missing an embedding. Expect 200 with counts.

Grounded, ranked suggestions for a support question: relevant incidents (up to 5 groups), every candidate's verdict, next steps, a customer draft and missing info. Filters and candidate_multiplier (1-5) are optional; remove the ones you do not need. Can take up to ~100 s. Expect 200 with status answered or no_relevant_incidents; 422 for an empty question. Copy the response X-Correlation-ID into correlation_id to fetch its trace.
The committed service catalog as {service: [events]}. Never calls the LLM. Expect 200.

The Langfuse trace of an earlier request, by its correlation id (variable correlation_id). Expect 200 with observations; 404 trace_not_ready while Langfuse is still ingesting it (a few seconds after the request) or if no trace has that id.
